I made all three shots, and each passed both the quick checks and the Unity test (bake, replay on two different humanoid rigs, plus facing, left/right and foot contact). Two needed a redo after I looked at the previews:

| Shot | Take kept | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Patrol walk (6 s) | first take | Straight walk forward, about 7.3 m. |
| 2. Hears noise, looks around (8 s) | second take | The first take passed the checks but showed no visible looking around, and he drifted on a curving path. In the redo he walks, stops sharply, then turns his head and body side to side. |
| 3. Spots friend, waves (6 s) | second take | In the first take the arm only came up briefly to about head height, which looked more like a salute. In the redo he raises his right arm above his head and waves from about 2.6 s to 5.1 s, then lowers it. |
